name: Upper Darby Summer Stage Children's Theatre
description_short: Teens who have finished 7th grade join one of six Upper Darby Summer Stage Children's Theatre productions, rehearsing with theatre professionals for three to four weeks at Haverford High School, Monday to Friday 9:00 to 4:30, and staging a one hour show for children with five performances for a live audience.
notes: $500 a production, and $500 for a second show. Participants are assigned to a show in spring and must attend every date, including one weekend rehearsal and two evening performances; no conflicts accepted. The site says summer 2027 is coming soon. Summer Stage also runs Summer Stage Junior classes for younger children at another site.
